figures.caption: Figure 1. R3-CoVR. A frozen multimodal LLM reasons about the after-effects of the edit and writes a concise target description (Stage 1); a frozen contrastive encoder embeds the description and the gallery and returns a top-K shortlist (Stage 2); the multimodal LLM then judges each shortlisted candidate against the intended result, and the judge score is blended with the retrieval rank to reorder the head of the list (Stage 3). No component is trained on challenge data.
